_about: The pairs (MAP exhibit id + local title) the blocker round left for Sam under its top two causes, as COBIx measured them on 2026-11-17 (tracker at 145a7a88, the 16 November audit bake): cause 1 CERT-NO-NAME (121 pairs, #3480 Source 22) and cause 2 LEFT-REFERENCED (95 pairs, Source 24). The blocker round that chose them is not rebuildable here (Source 28), so this file is its scope, committed once. kb/exhibit_blocker_rules.py re-decides every pair against the committed records; snapshot_* is COBIx's outcome, kept so a difference shows. College names are institutions; no student or staff data.
